source.n8n_access: read-only GET /executions only; no live execution has ever reached the poll loop (see hand-poll-completed.json). The input is the n8n error item media-poll-http emits under onError=continueRegularOutput.
source.rationale: The 'can never wedge' claim in the node header. media-poll-http failed (timeout / 404), so the item carries only {error}, no status: `polledOk` is falsy, and the node must still emit ONE well-formed MediaProcessResponse-shaped item so media-route can fall to the CRM fallback copy instead of the turn dead-ending. With no status of its own the node inherits one from prev.reason: 'failed' here (the poll that was fired to fetch a worker refusal), which keeps media-route on the failed branch and, because resp._polled is now true, sends it to the fallback reply rather than round-tripping the same poll again. `error` is flattened from the n8n error object to its .message string; tier/result/notices collapse to null/null/[] because nothing was actually read.
